title: Chapter 367
content:
Chapter 367

In the blink of an eye, the leader of the Heiwu people broke through many obstacles and came in front of Tomita Yoshinari, and he was about to achieve a one-hit kill.

Tomita Yoshinari looked at the black mist that was getting closer and closer to him, and there was a powerful person wrapped in the black mist.

The black mist at the edge has already touched his body, making it more and more difficult for his blocked internal force to move through the meridians.

His eyes were full of horror. Obviously, he also felt extremely unbelievable about the determination of these black mist men, and even created an indelible fear.

"No, no, absolutely not. How can I die here now after finally getting to where I am today. My ambition has not yet been fulfilled, and my skills have just been revealed. How can I die now."

Tomita Yoshinari shouted in his heart.

Immediately, his eyes sharpened, and he took out something from his arms.

During the groping, a blood-red coquettish blood lotus appeared in his hand, and there was a glistening black swimming in the blood lotus, full of a strange feeling.

Looking at the snow lotus full of strange beauty in front of him, a sick smile appeared on Tomita Yoshinari's face, and his eyes were even more greedy.

"That's it. Although it's been more than a year since I got it, every time I see it, I still feel extremely excited and reluctant to give up. It's really fascinating."

This blood lotus, but Yoshinari Tomita broke through the peak cultivation base of the fourth level before, and is about to step into the fifth level, but has not had the foundation of enlightenment for a long time, and is trapped in this bottleneck.

Then he had no choice but to take the risk to ask the Taoist master, and finally, under Zhong Yu's guidance and training, he bestowed this blood lotus, so that he could be enlightened.

Finally, half a year later, Tomita Yoshinari finally realized something and successfully broke through to the current fifth-order cultivation base. As a result, the blood lotus became the foundation of Yoshinari Tomita's enlightenment, and became a magic weapon that he relied heavily on.

It is naturally extremely precious to be a magic weapon for the world's strongest to break through to the fifth level.

Not only does the blood lotus have some kind of dao mark left by Zhong Yu, it can be used as an opportunity to achieve enlightenment, and it is also an extremely powerful weapon in itself, and its class quality has reached the level of a middle-grade spiritual weapon.

This is quite rare.

In the current world, the method of forging weapons is quite familiar, and it is still in the stage of exploration.

No matter how godlike or famous the weapons circulated all over Japan, after Zhong Yu's investigation, they found that they were nothing more than that.

As for the so-called three-foot Qiong Gouyu, the grass pheasant sword, and other so-called weapons of the supreme gods of Japan, according to Zhong Yu's calculations, they are just beginners' magic weapons, and they are not powerful.

Therefore, Tomita Yoshinari was able to bestow this precious and unusual blood lotus, which can not only understand the bad luck in it, improve his cultivation, but also use it to defend against the enemy. It is really a rare treasure with both offensive and defensive capabilities.

Usually he hides in his bosom, dare not leave his body for a moment, and feels disadvantaged even if he looks at it to others, so be careful of the baby.

Now he took it out and used it to fend off the enemy. He was really pushed to the extreme, and he couldn't control anything.

"Well, this blood lotus is so weird. It is worthy of being the commander of a party. Not only is it strong, but it also has such a rare treasure. It should not be underestimated, it's a pity."

The leader of the black mist man glanced at the blood lotus, and his mind was shocked, a sense of crisis emerged spontaneously, and then he sighed a few times, expressing regret.

If he usually encounters such a person with such a high cultivation base and a treasure, he must be careful to make friends, even if he cannot be a friend, he should not be an enemy.

But now that the world is in chaos and wars are everywhere, as long as there is something implicated and cared about in this mortal world, you will never be able to get away from it, and you will definitely be involved in it.

Don’t you see, even the three noble gods in the Japanese world, Tsukiyomi, Susanoo, and Amaterasu Omisami, all have to spend their time in the mortal world for their own blood and morals, and set up many secrets to participate in the human world? The matter of fighting the dragon.

And the leader of the Heiwu people, although his cultivation base has reached the peak of the mortal world, he still has a concern after all, and he can't get away from him.

So this time, he had no choice but to accept the invitation of his country's tyrants, to personally participate in and direct this ambush, really helpless.

Up to now, both sides have forged a deep blood feud, and Tomita Yoshinari's side has been killed thousands of elites, and their strength has been reduced by half.

On my side, more than a dozen masters have also fallen, and among them are several of my juniors and old friends who have been friends for a long time.

"I can't drag it on any longer. Although most of the remaining troops around have been crippled, after a period of recovery, they can still have a lot of combat power. If you can't take advantage of this time to kill the commander in front of you, I'm afraid The time has passed, and it is too late to regret."

The leader of the black fog man thought to himself, and a stern look appeared in his eyes.

Although Tomita Yoshinari sacrificed the blood lotus in front of him, and then turned into a rosette, protecting him tightly, the defense was airtight.

However, this does not mean that it is truly safe.

There is no absolute defense in the world. The reason why it couldn't be broken was because it didn't find the right method, or it was lack of strength.

And the leader of the black mist man in front of him looked at the blood lotus in front of him exuding a strange blood-colored light, in which there was a surge of black mist, and a cold air suddenly filled the air. There are countless grimaces surging in the blood light, obviously this blood lotus is not a good thing, it is extremely evil.

Although this kind of magic weapon seems to be out of order, it is nothing at all to Japan in this troubled world.

It's just a magical treasure, even if the whole person turns into a monster to slaughter the world, as long as there is enough power, no one will dare to disobey it.

It may be said that he will also feel admiration for his powerful power, which will generate a heart of surrender.

This is this kind of strange morbid psychology, which is shared by the entire island nation. They are in awe of the strong and the devil who dares to kill the four, but abandon the weak. For those kind-hearted people who show kindness, it is regarded as a manifestation of stupidity and cowardice.

To get along with it, on the surface, it may be false and obedient because of temporary benefits. But once it is useless, it will be worse and abandoned.

Therefore, in today's world, it is common to see powerful monsters gather their subordinates, seize a place and roar in all directions, and even participate in the competition for the world's people, arrogant.

The leader of the black mist man tried to attack a few times, but found that Tomita Yoshinari, who was protected by the snow lotus, couldn't stand the slightest influence. His own attacks were powerless even to break through the blood light barrier, as if all the attacks were useless.

"Damn it, has it really reached that point?"

The leader of the Black Mist Man's eyes flickered, as if he had made some kind of decision, and then with a gaze that implied detachment, he fixedly looked at Tomita Yoshinari who was hiding behind the blood light and leisurely looking at him , said slowly.

"It seems that I can't escape, and I have already had this kind of awareness since the moment I went down the mountain. It is not a burden to be able to compete with a strong man like you before dying, and to be a companion on the road. This body is cultivated."

These words seemed to contain the meaning of death, and the leader in front of him also burst out with a breath of great enlightenment, as if he had penetrated something.

Tomita Yoshinari looked at the leader of the black fog people in front of him, and a very bad sense of crisis gushed out from his heart.
